readme.html:
data-master

Turn a messy dataset into an auditable PDF report from one command.

中文 · Examples · Evaluation · Roadmap · Launch kit

data-master preserves the raw input, makes every cleaning decision explicit, runs statistics only at the level the data supports, tests sensitivity, and delivers Markdown, PDF and machine-readable evidence. It is a Codex skill and a standalone cross-platform CLI.

Try it

Requires Node.js 20+ and Python 3.11+.

npm install -g github:MAGA2010/data-master#v0.3.0
data-master setup
data-master skill install
data-master demo --out outputs/first-demo

For an additional format parser, install it only into the managed environment:

data-master setup --extra h5py

Optional format parsers are never installed automatically. This option accepts a package name only; use a parser named in its official format documentation.

Open outputs/first-demo/report.pdf, then inspect the verdict in outputs/first-demo/audit/final_audit.md.

If the verified demo is useful, star the repository so other researchers and analysts can find it.

The npm package has no install hooks and no JavaScript dependencies. setup is the only command that downloads Python dependencies; it creates an isolated environment. skill install atomically installs the bundled skill and refuses to overwrite an existing copy.

Why use it

A plausible analysis can fail when… data-master records or prevents it by…
02134 silently becomes 2134 Reading delimited cells as text until an explicit conversion is approved
Repeated rows inflate the sample size Declaring the independent unit and moving the primary analysis to that level
Cleaning alters an unrelated column Comparing untouched columns with the raw input in text space
A p-value appears without context Saving the test, n, df, effect size, interval and correction family
“Robust” means one convenient re-fit Running saved leave-one-group-out, jackknife, fence and complete-case perturbations
A polished report hides an unresolved decision Producing the report and a separate audit that can still refuse submission
A resumed run reuses changed evidence Hashing stage artifacts, code, references, dependencies and run options

The audit enforces reporting discipline. It does not replace statistical judgment, collection context, peer review or a study protocol.

What you receive

outputs/
|-- report.pdf                     primary human-readable report
|-- report.md                      citable report source
|-- report.html                    self-contained shareable export of report.md
|-- executive_summary.md
|-- state.json                     stage ledger and provenance
|-- answers.template.json          decisions that require a human
|-- analysis/
|   |-- profile.json
|   |-- descriptive.json
|   |-- inferential.json
|   `-- sensitivity.json
|-- cleaned/
|   |-- cleaned.csv
|   |-- clean_<dataset>.py         replayable cleaning program
|   `-- validation.json
|-- charts/
`-- audit/
    |-- final_audit.md
    `-- final_audit.json

Verify a delivered run without modifying it:

data-master verify outputs/first-demo --json

Analyze your data

data-master analyze measurements.csv \
  --out outputs/study \
  --group treatment \
  --unit-key participant_id \
  --outcomes response_time,accuracy

Resume interrupted work:

data-master resume outputs/study/state.json

If a conversion or study decision is unsafe to infer, the run writes answers.template.json. Fill its stable decision IDs and resume with:

data-master resume outputs/study/state.json --answers outputs/study/answers.json

Comparisons are labelled exploratory unless the run explicitly declares --unit-key, --group, and --outcomes. The report and answers.template.json show which declarations are missing. Supply all three to treat the comparison as confirmatory.

Use data-master analyze --help for all pipeline options, including declared covariates, journal/checklist routing, input-size limits, lockfile export and PDF backend selection.

Unknown binary formats are profiled locally. File bytes, headers, metadata and records are never sent to web search. Pickle-based files (.pkl, .pickle, .joblib, .dill, .pck, .pckl, .pt, .pth) are refused by default because loading them can execute code.

Reproducible case studies

Case Failure being tested Evidence
Identifier traps Leading zeros, dates, currency and mixed values are silently retyped Plan, replay and untouched-column validation
Date or number? 20240115 is an integer and a date; the file does not say which coerce_numeric_or_date hold with evidence and an answers-file resolution
Synthetic survey Survey labels, -999 missing codes and zero-padded ids are silently retyped or imputed Three evidenced holds; labels and codes survive cleaning
Repeated rows Technical or repeated observations are counted as independent samples Unit-level primary analysis and labelled row-level secondary
Audit refusal A complete-looking report is treated as submission-ready without a defined unit Report delivered; audit gate remains failed

Every case links its raw synthetic input, command and inspectable artifacts.

Supported inputs

Input Current behavior
CSV, TSV, Excel, JSON, JSONL, Parquet, single-table SQLite (.sqlite, .sqlite3, .db) Full profile, cleaning, unit-aware analysis, sensitivity, charts, report and audit
Timestamped tabular data Audited descriptive trend, slope interval, autocorrelation, decomposition and changepoint screen
Text, image, audio or geospatial data Explicitly labelled integrity profile and profile-only report
Mixed folders Per-modality profiles and a combined profile-only report

Full inferential analysis currently applies to one tabular file. Time-series mode is descriptive and does not forecast. Unsupported methods remain marked as unsupported instead of being replaced with a weaker claim.

Other installation paths

Install the Python package from a clone:

git clone https://github.com/MAGA2010/data-master.git
cd data-master
python -m venv .venv
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install .
# macOS/Linux: .venv/bin/python -m pip install .
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\data-master.exe doctor
# macOS/Linux: .venv/bin/data-master doctor
# Windows: .venv\Scripts\data-master.exe skill install
# macOS/Linux: .venv/bin/data-master skill install

The Python package path uses the activated project virtual environment. The data-master setup --extra <package> helper is provided by the npm launcher; when it is unavailable, an unknown-format branch stays profile-only instead of installing a parser into another interpreter.

Run directly from a checkout:

python scripts/run_pipeline.py \
  --in examples/iris/iris_dirty.csv \
  --out outputs/iris-demo \
  --title "Iris morphometrics" \
  --journal nature

Use a release tag or commit SHA in GitHub npm specifications when reproducible installation matters. The project is not currently published to the npm or PyPI registries.

Evidence and methodology

  • Evaluation dashboard
  • Validation and release checks
  • Architecture and design decisions
  • Workflow contract
  • Cleaning rules
  • Statistical reporting gates
  • Journal and EQUATOR routing
  • Current roadmap

CI exercises Windows and Linux with Python 3.11, 3.12 and 3.13, and runs the distribution suite on Windows, Linux and macOS with Python 3.13. Numerical tests compare key methods with independent equations or reference implementations. Distribution tests build and install the actual wheel and npm tarball outside the checkout before running the demo and verifying its evidence. The skill has also been installed and driven end to end in ZCode 3.14.4 on Windows (see Evaluation).

Scope boundaries

  • Missingness mechanisms remain undetermined without collection context.
  • Covariates are declared by the user; the pipeline does not select them from outcomes.
  • Failed mixed models remain unresolved rather than falling back to an invalid independent-row test.
  • Forecasting, causal identification and arbitrary row deletion are outside the current contract.
  • Artifact verification detects changes against the saved ledger; it cannot establish authenticity if both artifacts and ledger are rewritten.

See the open roadmap for planned compatibility and evaluation work.

Contributing

External datasets, failure reports and small focused pull requests are welcome. Start with CONTRIBUTING.md and the contribution-sized roadmap tasks.

A statistical decision change needs a regression or numerical-reference test that would have failed before the change. Remove personal and confidential data before opening an issue.

Citation and license

Citation metadata is available in CITATION.cff. Every run records the package version or repository commit that produced it.

skills.name: data-master
skills.description: Analyze datasets with preserved raw inputs, explicit cleaning decisions, reproducible figures and PDF reports. Full statistics for one tabular file; descriptive time-series analysis; integrity profiling for text, image, audio, geographic and mixed inputs. Use for data cleaning, EDA, group comparison

skills.name: data-cleaner
skills.description: Turn profile.json into a deterministic cleaning plan, execute only the planned operations, and prove byte-for-byte reproducibility. Additive-only.

skills.name: data-explorer
skills.description: Descriptive analysis and EDA on cleaned data: distributions, missingness mechanism screen, correlations, categorical structure. No p-values for group comparisons.

skills.name: data-profiler
skills.description: Profile a dataset without changing it: shape, dtypes, missingness, duplicates, distributions, anomalies, candidate group/target/time columns. Emits profile.json.

skills.name: data-router
skills.description: Classify any input path into one of eight modalities and emit a route manifest. First stage of data-master; no statistics, no cleaning.

skills.name: data-transformer
skills.description: Derive analysis variables from cleaned data under an explicit, reversible transformation ledger. No silent recoding, no leakage.

skills.name: data-validator
skills.description: Run the 8 Nature statistical gates and the journal checklist against the finished artifacts. Writes audit/final_audit.md and refuses the label submission-ready on a mandatory FAIL.

skills.name: deep-analyzer
skills.description: Optional modelling stage: regression, mixed effects, clustering, dimensionality reduction, forecasting. Only runs when the design supports it; every model carries diagnostics.

skills.name: report-generator
skills.description: Assemble report.md, executive_summary.md and report.pdf from the artifacts. Every number is registered against its source; the PDF is the primary deliverable and the Markdown is the citable source.

skills.name: statistical-analyzer
skills.description: Choose and run the inferential test from the data structure, with effect sizes, CIs, multiplicity correction and explicit rejected alternatives. Refuses to report a p-value it cannot estimate.

skills.name: visualizer
skills.description: Decide and render one figure per argument: chart type chosen against alternatives, title states the finding, caption defines the encoding, body gives fact -> interpretation -> implication.
